mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT, R.MIN_STAY_NGT_CNT, COUNT(C.STAY_DATE) AS SELLABLE_NIGHTS, SUM(C.PRICE_AMT) AS TOTAL_PRICE FROM ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.HOUSE_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN ROOM_CALENDAR C ON C.ROOM_SN = R.ROOM_SN AND C.STAY_DATE >= #{checkIn} AND C.STAY_DATE < #{checkOut} AND C.CLOSED_YN = 'N' AND C.PRICE_AMT > 0 AND (C.TOTAL_QTY - C.SOLD_QTY) >= #{qty} WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.ROOM_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRTNR_MST P JOIN USER_ACNT U ON U.USER_SN = P.USER_SN WHERE P.PRTNR_SN = H.PRTNR_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND P.APRV_STTS = 'APPROVED' AND U.ACNT_STTS = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY R.ROOM_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT, R.MIN_STAY_NGT_CNT ORDER BY R.ROOM_SN

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM_CALENDAR RC JOIN ROOM R ON RC.ROOM_SN = R.ROOM_SN WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.ROOM_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND RC.STAY_DATE >= #{fromDate} AND RC.PRICE_AMT > 0 AND RC.CLOSED_YN = 'N' AND RC.TOTAL_QTY > RC.SOLD_QTY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM_CALENDAR RC WHERE RC.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND RC.STAY_DATE >= #{fromDate} AND RC.PRICE_AMT > 0 AND RC.CLOSED_YN = 'N' AND RC.TOTAL_QTY > RC.SOLD_QTY
